* [Key Metrics] Token unit price dropped 21.2% in six weeks to an average of $0.45 per million tokens.
* [Key Position & Outlook] The widening gap between inference volume and revenue indicates an entry into a defensive pricing cycle.

* [Key Metrics] Moonshot AI canceled $150M cloud compute contract due to regulatory tightening.
* [Key Position & Outlook] TSMC and Samsung suspend advanced processor shipments to Chinese clients.

## Section 3: Flagship Technical Dissections

### Claude Code CLI & Terminal Autonomous Agent: Architecture, Shell Sandboxing & Enterprise Cost Optimization
